known_failures: Cautery-crushed and muscle-like tissue at the margins is not one of the head's training classes. The 'unlike training tissue' rule keeps most of it out of the map, but small fragments on it may still read as invasive carcinoma (checked by eye on tile contact sheets, 2026-10-27). Check small tumor pieces and islands here by eye before relying on them; the main tumor and its front sit on carcinoma.
